rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unencrypted Cardholder Data Transmission
rules.description: Detects transmission of cardholder data over unencrypted channels violating PCI-DSS Requirement 4
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "pci" or Message contains "dss" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 1 // AZ-PCI-001

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Default Credentials in Cardholder Environment
